findings.title: Protocol-relative baseUrl in createApiClient is not pinned down by the specification
findings.detail: createApiClient rejects a path starting with '//' (such as '//evil.test/x') with RangeError, but for baseUrl it only checks that non-empty values start with '/'. A protocol-relative baseUrl such as '//evil.test' passes that check and produces '//evil.test/x'.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN createApiClient is configured with a protocol-relative baseUrl such as "//evil.test" and requests "/x" THEN it sends the request to "//evil.test/x" without throwing RangeError.

findings.title: Protocol-relative baseUrl in createApiClient is not pinned down by the specification
findings.detail: createApiClient rejects a path starting with '//' (such as '//evil.test/x') with RangeError, but for baseUrl it only checks that non-empty values start with '/'. A protocol-relative baseUrl such as '//evil.test' passes that check and produces '//evil.test/x'.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN createApiClient is configured with a protocol-relative baseUrl such as "//evil.test" and requests "/x" THEN it sends the request to "//evil.test/x" without throwing RangeError.

riskiest_assumptions: The implementation of registerWebApp, isWebBuilt, DEFAULT_WEB_DIST, and classifyWebPath in part 2 (src/api/web.ts and src/api/web-paths.ts) matches the contracts relied upon by src/main.ts and web/src/app/reserved-roots.test.ts.
Part 1 of the diff properly implements the remaining criteria whose source files are not included in Part 2.
